findings.title: 3D Review is too old
findings.what: This is 3d-review-cli 0.8.0, but the rules need 0.9.0 or later.
findings.why: An older version may not know every rule the technical artist has set, so files can be checked against the wrong rules, or not at all.
findings.how: Update 3D Review to version 0.9.0 or later, then check again.

findings.title: Mostly hard edges
findings.what: Parts where most edges are hard (the faces on each side shade separately). Found 12 edges in one object. Measured 100 %; the profile allows at most 50 %.
findings.why: Every hard edge doubles the points along it on the GPU, so a part that is mostly hard edges is mostly duplicate points. Faceted shading is often a sign normals were lost.
findings.how: Soften the edges that are not meant to be sharp, or set smoothing groups by angle.

findings.title: Texel density
findings.what: Parts whose texture pixels per meter are far from the profile's target, for the texture size it names. Found in one object. Measured 256 px/m; the profile allows 512 px/m to 2048 px/m.
findings.why: Parts sharpen or blur next to each other when their texel density differs, which reads as an inconsistent asset.
findings.how: Scale the part's UV islands towards the target density.
